'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is produced at the [[Church workbench]] by combining the basic fertilizer [[peat]] with a [[growth enhancer]], the latter requiring an introduction to [[alchemy]]. Like all fertilizers, a single unit may be applied to a single farming plot - either an [[empty garden bed]], [[garden bed with sticks]], or [[vine trellis]] - in order to provide a benefit to the subsequently planted crop.

The benefit of a "Quality" fertilizer - note the star icon - is an overall improvement to a crop's yield. In regards to {{PAGENAME}} specifically, the given crop's return on average will be improved moderately. With basic crops, the produce will be increased by 4 and the seeds will be increased by 2. With quality crops, the produce and seeds will be increased by 1, identical to peat, however it also guarantees 1 upgraded produce and seed. If the crop itself is already gold-quality, this benefit will simply be added to the return, or 2 extra produce and seeds total. For additional information regarding the effects and use of fertilizer, see [[farming]].
